original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：变压器被盗致利欣加机场暂停夜间航班——莫桑比克机场公司
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克机场公司（AdM）表示，利欣加机场约40盏跑道灯供电的变压器被盗，导致夜间航班暂停，造成2050万梅蒂卡尔损失。该公司负责行政与财务的执行董事Saíde Mahoma Júnior称，这起发生在莫桑比克北部尼亚萨省机场的盗窃破坏了跑道照明运行，也影响低能见度条件下的降落。尼亚萨省国务秘书Silva Livone谴责破坏行为，并警告将严厉追究责任人。

location.raw_text: Lichinga Airport, Niassa province, northern Mozambique

key_facts.fact: 利欣加机场约40盏跑道灯供电的变压器被盗，导致夜间航班暂停
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The theft of transformers supplying around 40 runway lights at Lichinga Airport has forced the suspension of night flights

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克机场公司称相关损失达2050万梅蒂卡尔（约28.73万欧元）
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: losses associated with repeated acts of vandalism, including the theft of transformers and destruction of lights, amount to 20.5 million meticais (€287,300)

key_facts.fact: 盗窃发生在莫桑比克北部尼亚萨省的机场
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the theft at the airport in Niassa province, northern Mozambique

key_facts.fact: 尼亚萨省国务秘书谴责破坏行为并警告将严厉追究责任人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Niassa State Secretary Silva Livone also condemned the acts of vandalism and warned that the authorities would take firm action against those responsible

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Club of Mozambique，转引Lusa）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
盗窃具体实施者及作案细节尚未确认
